Apple Watch offers a wide range of customisable watch faces so you can personalise your Watch, and the popular Modular face has become even more feature-rich in watchOS 27.

watchOS 27 adds 13 new colour options to the Modular face, along with more complications

Modular has long been a popular Apple Watch face because of its versatility and in-depth customisation options.

This face is so popular that Apple has even released derivative versions such as Modular Compact and Modular Ultra, with the latest addition being Siri Modular.

But even the standard 'Modular' hasn't stopped evolving. In watchOS 27, Apple has added 13 new colour options to this face, letting you customise it to your liking.

Here are the new colours for Modular in watchOS 27:

  • Olive Green
  • Wine Red
  • Sand
  • Magenta
  • Mint Green
  • Wildflower Blue
  • Navy Blue
  • Light Ochre
  • Light Blue
  • Limestone
  • Camel
  • Sage Green
  • Mulberry

When customising the Modular face, you'll see all of the above colours in watchOS 27 when you get to the colour screen. You can scroll all the way down and tap the '+' button that says 'Tap to add more colors' to browse and add previous colours.

In addition to these new colour options, Modular can also use the latest complications that are exclusive to Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12.

Complications such as Steps, Heart Rate, and Fitness Readiness are available in multiple sizes, allowing you to track important health data directly on the watch face.

What's your favourite Apple Watch face? Let us know in the comments.
